subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y11 lesson 49 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Section C set 2 (our own questions) and mark scheme)
intro: Lesson 49: Section C exam questions: 3.6 to 3.9. To understand how to answer Section C questions on jihad, festivals, family and leadership

questions.q: Explain two ways the guardian hadith applies to Muslim citizens. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Each person is responsible for those in their care (family, work); leaders answer for their people, so citizens act responsibly and leaders serve.
questions.model: Point 1: every Muslim has responsibility. Develop: 'every one of you is a guardian ... responsible for his flock' (Bukhari and Muslim): parents, workers, pupils. Point 2: leaders are accountable. Develop: the ruler is a guardian and will be asked about his people.

questions.q: Section C set 2 on the pupil PDF (our own questions): four 4-mark questions on 3.6 to 3.9 and one 12-mark: 'Eid-ul-Fitr is more important than Eid-ul-Adha.' Assess. Timed: 25 minutes.
questions.a: Mark-scheme style answers; 12-mark uses Abu 'Ubaid's hadith and a justified judgement
questions.model: Teacher answers the first 4-mark question aloud.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: how would you explain jihad?
questions.a: Greater inner struggle first; lesser jihad defensive with strict conditions.
